hook: Typing band karo. ChatGPT mein ab bolo, aur likha hua saath saath dikhega.

beats.narration: Typing band karo. ChatGPT mein ab bolo, aur likha hua saath saath dikhega.
OpenAI ne eighteen November ko Live Dictation launch kiya. Aap bolte jaate ho, text turant aata jaata hai.
beats.claim: Live Dictation transcribes speech as you talk (18 Nov 2026).

beats.narration: Pehle das minute ki recording limit thi. Ab wo hata di gayi hai.
beats.claim: The 10-minute recording limit has been removed.

beats.narration: Ye sab plans pe hai, free wale pe bhi. iPhone, Android, web aur desktop app, sab jagah.
beats.claim: Available on all ChatGPT plans on iOS, Android, web and desktop, rolling out globally.

beats.narration: Waveform pe tap karo to text chhupa ya dikha sakte ho.
beats.claim: Tap or click the waveform to show or hide the text.

beats.narration: Lambe message, notes ya email draft? Bol ke likho, phir ChatGPT se saaf karwa lo.
Aapke phone pe aaya? Comment mein batao.

title: ChatGPT mein bolo, likha hua turant dikhega. 10 min limit khatam
description: 18 Nov 2026: ChatGPT Live Dictation sab plans pe, iOS, Android, web aur desktop. Bolte bolte text dikhta hai, aur 10 minute ki recording limit hata di gayi. Source: OpenAI release notes (Releasebot).
